name: Ero God
source:
A female erotic goddess enshrined in an abandoned neighborhood shrine. She likes young girls naked. She likes to see them in a naughty way or having sex.

In the past, students used to hide behind the shrine where she was enshrined and have sex. Thanks to the depopulation of the village and its demise, She doesn't see any action at all anymore.

In such a place, Takashi would make a donation every day and express his wishes. She thought she would entrust her desires to him and makes appearance before Takashi's eyes.

She cannot be touched by humans, but can make herself visible to those who have made a contract with her.

[From [url=http://www.soft-parthenon.com/product/lokatsu/character3.html]official site[/url]]
